title: 3D 代码模型指纹受控探针
usage: 同一模型 / effort tier 必须使用题目原文，不要在样本间改写或添加额外要求。
每个标签至少跨 3 个探针、3 个独立会话；同一会话的重试不计为独立样本。
只保存可见精确模型 ID 与 effort tier 已被人工确认的完整原始 HTML 成果。
不执行导入 HTML；系统仅做静态代码结构分析。

probes.title: 模块化温室 / 层级与动画
probes.purpose: Scene hierarchy, primitive assembly, transform conventions, render loop and resize handling.
probes.prompt: Create one self-contained HTML file using three.js from a CDN only. Build a small low-poly kinetic greenhouse entirely from built-in THREE geometries: a glass house frame, six planter boxes, a central wind spinner, and three floating seed pods. Use no external models, images, textures, fonts, or modules other than three.js and OrbitControls. Assemble named parts with Groups, use physically based materials and at least two light types, add a gentle idle animation with distinct motion for the spinner and pods, support drag rotate and zoom, handle resize, and make the file work when opened by double-click. Put all HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in the single file.

probes.title: 深海观测器 / 程序化形体与灯光
probes.purpose: Geometry selection, material defaults, helper usage, procedural placement and code organization.
probes.prompt: Deliver a single double-clickable HTML file that uses only a three.js CDN plus OrbitControls. Create a stylized deep-sea observation drone from primitive geometries in code: a pressure hull, three articulated sensor arms, a ring of eight portholes, two spotlights, and a seabed made from repeated rocks. Do not load any external model, image, texture, shader file, font, or data file. Use an orthographic/perspective camera choice you justify in code comments, animate a slow patrol and light pulse, provide mouse/touch rotate and zoom, and include a responsive resize handler. Keep the entire implementation in one HTML file.

probes.title: 等距工厂单元 / 交互与状态
probes.purpose: Event architecture, raycasting, DOM/three.js split, state naming, and procedural factory functions.
probes.prompt: Write one self-contained HTML file with three.js loaded from a CDN and no other external dependency. Make an isometric mini factory scene using only built-in geometries: a conveyor, four color-coded crates, a robotic picker built from boxes and cylinders, and a status panel rendered with ordinary HTML/CSS. Add OrbitControls rotate/zoom, hover highlighting through raycasting, click a crate to select it and update the status panel, an idle conveyor animation, shadows, lights, and a resize handler. No external assets, textures, images, models, fonts, or downloaded files. It must run directly on double-click.

probes.title: 天文仪器 / 约束与数学运动
probes.purpose: Math/style fingerprints in parametric motion, grouping, camera setup, and renderer configuration.
probes.prompt: Generate a single-file three.js HTML artifact that runs on double-click and imports only three.js and OrbitControls from CDN. Construct a tabletop mechanical orrery entirely from primitive geometries: a brass base, three orbit rings, a sun, two planets, a moon, labels made with CSS only, and a toggle button for pause/resume. Implement nested orbital motion with explicit time-based equations, drag rotate and zoom, antialiasing, pixel-ratio handling, resize handling, and a calm dark background. Do not use external models, textures, images, fonts, SVG files, shaders, or any other package.
